## Report

`tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py::test_rerun_502_body_has_no_exception_detail` FAILS on current `origin/main` (reproduced standalone at 43ecfa8f27, and independently at 9bdb22f5887 before that):

```
AttributeError: 'types.SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute 'headers'
src/rebar/review_bot/app.py:101: in _request_token
    header_token = request.headers.get(TOKEN_HEADER, "").strip()
```

## Mechanism (unconfirmed — for the investigation to prove)

`_request_token` (`src/rebar/review_bot/app.py:101`) reads `request.headers` unconditionally. The header path was added for ticket 66af (accept the token via header, keeping the query param for legacy Gerrit webhooks whose `webhooks.config` has not been re-pushed). The test constructs its request as a `types.SimpleNamespace` that predates that change and carries no `headers` attribute, so the attribute read raises before any assertion runs.

Whether the correct fix is to make `_request_token` tolerate a header-less request object, or to update the test's fake to match the real request contract, is EXACTLY the question the investigation must answer — a header-less request may be a real shape in production (some ASGI/test clients) or may be purely a test artifact. Do not assume.

## Why it matters

This is red on main. It reds the `Verified` CI gate for anyone whose change touches this suite, and it is a SECURITY-adjacent guard: the test exists to prove a 502 body carries no exception detail (path-injection guard). A guard test that errors before asserting proves nothing — the guarantee it is supposed to pin is currently unverified.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The root cause is proven, with a cited mechanism, not guessed — the stale  double at tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py:163-166, left behind when 66af (4e8c83c833) widened  (app.py:101) to read  first
- [x] It is established and stated whether a header-less request is a REAL production shape or a test-only artifact, with evidence — **TEST ARTIFACT**. starlette HTTPConnection.headers (requests.py:132-136) is an unconditional property; deleting  from an ASGI scope raises KeyError, NEVER AttributeError, so the observed AttributeError is only producible by a non-Request object. A real request with zero caller headers still carries an empty . FastAPI binds the param behind an isinstance gate (fastapi/dependencies/utils.py:711). See the Phase 1 RCA comment.
- [x] The test passes on a clean tree and actually exercises its original assertion (a 502 body containing no exception detail), not merely stops erroring — proven by defect-seeded mutation: adding  to the 502 body returns the test to RED naming the leaked string. The original test could not have caught that; it raised before its first assert.
- [x] A regression test fails against the pre-fix code and passes after — two mutations of the production path each return it to RED (leak -> assertion diff; header read stubbed -> 401), and it is GREEN with app.py byte-identical to main.
- [x] The fix lands on main through Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 — change 1481 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1481), LLM-Review+1 (PASS) + Verified+1 (run 31167914711 SUCCESS), MERGED 2026-08-07 10:17:28 as origin/main aaf71639b8.
